[NDBG.2.2] **Schemas:** `ds_engine_schema_count` / `_schema_find` / `_schema_at`
enumerate registered schemas, the engine's built-in `internal` schemas
([LSCP.2.6.2]) among them; the `ds_schema_get_*` family reads a schema's name,
lifecycle, ttl, slots, source location (`SchemaSource` atom), and generated `.proto`
text (`SchemaDef` atom). The lifecycle of a built-in schema reads as `internal`
(`ds_schema_lifecycle_t`), which is how an integrator tells it from an author
schema: by the lifecycle, never by the name.
